ServiceSection.title: An-Nusra's Services
ServiceSection.subtitle: Let everyone have a happy life
ServiceSection.description: Our activities, social development, and humanitarian works are in accordance with Quran-Sunnah.

services.title: Education
services.description: Establishing curriculum and textbooks, setting up educational institutions, and managing them by integrating modern education with Quran-Sunnah.

services.title: Service
services.description: Organizing activities to distribute winter clothes, iftar during Ramadan, clothes and Eid materials to the needy, and distributing sacrificial animals to the poor.
projects: Healthcare for Distressed Women and Children

services.title: Da'wah
services.description: Managing family counseling department and religious inquiry call center to maintain a religious environment at the family level.

services.title: Islamic Economics
services.description: Providing financial assistance for self-reliance through training in handicrafts, machine industry, technical skills, agriculture, and farm management to eliminate unemployment and poverty.

services.title: Islamic Culture
services.description: Building Islamic cultural centers and organizing various cultural competitions like Islamic music, poetry recitation, calligraphy for the entertainment and moral awakening of children and adolescents.

ServiceSection.ctaTitle: Want to be a partner in establishing a Quran-Sunnah based society?
ServiceSection.ctaDescription: Your sincere participation will help play a role in the journey of establishing society and humanitarian work in the light of Quran-Sunnah.

ActivitiesSection.title: Current activities
ActivitiesSection.description: An-Nusra Foundation is active in various activities aimed at the welfare of humanity and social prosperity. Each activity is carried out with 100% integrity, transparency, and accountability, maintaining the Sharia system.

Programs.heroSubtitle: As-Sunnah Foundation works with sustainable and long-term planning not just temporary assistance to improve people's lives.
Programs.partnerWithUs: Be Our Partner in Serving Humanity
Programs.donationText: Your small contribution can change the future of a neglected person. Donate to your favorite project today.

programsList.title: Education and Skill Development
programsList.description: Providing scholarships to poor and brilliant students and technical training through As-Sunnah Skill Development.

programsList.title: Self-reliance Project
programsList.description: Making poor families permanently free from poverty by providing them with rickshaws, sewing machines or capital for small businesses.

programsList.title: Health and Medical Services
programsList.description: Ensuring medical assistance to helpless patients, free medical camps and emergency medicine supply.

programsList.title: Pure Water Project
programsList.description: Installing deep tube wells for arsenic-free pure water in remote and coastal areas of the country.

programsList.title: Environment and Tree Plantation
programsList.description: Planting lakhs of fruit and forest trees across the country every year to combat climate change.

programsList.title: Disaster Management
programsList.description: Providing quick relief and assistance to victims of floods, cyclones or any natural disaster.
